criterion: artifact iff (C1) frac_zero_cam == 1.0 at the resolved layer features.17, AND (C2) some candidate layer has frac_zero_cam == 0.0 and pointing_acc above the per-patch chance rate plus two standard errors, where chance is the mean nodule-mask area fraction over the same 60 samples, AND (C3) mean Spearman between the CAM at that layer and the fully weight-randomised CAM is below 0.5. not_artifact if C1 fails (the resolved layer already produces a usable map). inconclusive otherwise: C1 without C2 means no layer recovers localisation; C1 and C2 without C3 means the recovered map does not depend on the trained weights and is an edge detector.
